journal: J. Chem. Eng. Data 28 (3), 300-305 (article begins at foot of p. 300; tables on p. 301)
title: Densities of aqueous NaCl, KCl, MgCl2, and CaCl2 binary solutions in the concentration range 0.5-6.1 m at 25, 30, 35, 40, and 45 C
needs_pass2_reason: text layer is a noisy OCR (spaced decimal points); CSVs were written entirely from 300-dpi image crops, every cell read against the image, no correction needed after reading; scan quality good.
experimental_method: Mettler/Paar DMA 55 oscillating-tube densitometer, calibrated with air and distilled-deionized water; sample temperature controlled to +/-0.03 C; NaCl, KCl, CaCl2 solutions by weight from oven-dried salts, MgCl2 and CaCl2 concentrations checked by gravimetric chloride (AgCl) analysis; measured at 1 atm
